title: Microsoft Edge: Commercial Journeys (Get things done) task cards on the Copilot new tab page
summary: Hold: the Edge automation entries are policy descriptions, not documented executable commands or API operations. The Edge navigation also needs the actual Microsoft 365 admin center labels. The roadmap dates, administrator opt-in default, licence prerequisites and local retention period are supported.

claims.where: controls[0].ui
claims.claim: The admin navigation route is Edge management service > Copilot.
claims.quote: In the main left navigation bar, go to Settings > Microsoft Edge.
claims.fix: Set the surface to 'Microsoft 365 admin center' and the path to 'Settings > Microsoft Edge > Copilot'. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-management-service for the entry route and retain the Commercial Journeys docs link for its hidden policy. The feature page gives https://admin.cloud.microsoft/#/Edge/Copilot as the direct address; retain that address in the note.

claims.where: controls[0].api
claims.claim: Edge policy CommercialJourneysGetThingsDoneEnabled = Enabled is the automation call that enables Commercial Journeys.
claims.quote: Searched: 'CommercialJourneysGetThingsDoneEnabled policy reference automation group Edge management'; opened Commercial Journeys and the Edge policy index. The feature page names a hidden policy but gives no executable command or API operation.
claims.fix: Set controls[0].api to null. Keep 'CommercialJourneysGetThingsDoneEnabled' in the note as the documented hidden policy name, not as an automation call. The feature page at https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-management-commercial-journeys documents enabling the policy through the Copilot tab but publishes no scripting operation.

claims.where: controls[1].ui
claims.claim: The admin navigation route is Edge management service > Copilot > Copilot new tab page.
claims.quote: In the main left navigation bar, go to Settings > Microsoft Edge.
claims.fix: Set the surface to 'Microsoft 365 admin center' and the path to 'Settings > Microsoft Edge > Copilot > Copilot new tab page'. Add https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-management-service to sources for the entry route; retain the current docs link, which documents switching to Copilot and selecting the Copilot new tab page dropdown.

claims.where: controls[1].api
claims.claim: Edge policy CopilotNewTabPageEnabled = Enabled is an executable automation call.
claims.quote: Searched: 'CopilotNewTabPageEnabled automation command set Edge policy registry' and 'CopilotNewTabPageEnabled HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE HKLM reg add'; opened its policy reference and reg add. The printed expression is not a command on either reference.
claims.fix: Remove the pseudo-command from controls[1].api. Retain the documented configuration in the row note instead: 'The Windows policy reference documents the mandatory registry path SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, value CopilotNewTabPageEnabled, type REG_DWORD, enabled value 0x00000001; it does not print a runnable command.' If the API side is null, qualify that side as the absence of a published callable operation, not the absence of registry configuration. Retain https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies/copilotnewtabpageenabled as the configuration reference.
